title: Shared ground: Name the adult load
categoryContext: Safety, relationships and repair across ages
stageSummary: Notice adult pressure, observable cues and the sentence that is about to leave the mouth.
pressureLine: I don't have time for this.
possibleWeather: The same words can land differently across children and contexts. Hold the need while leaving room to check the impact.
practice: separate adult urgency from the child's worth
principle: Recognise how adult overload changes tone and pacing.
nextSentence: The task still matters. Let's pause and separate adult urgency from the child's worth.
keyLearning: Recognise how adult overload changes tone and pacing.
